what: A hand-started 'send to everyone' run that moves a build already on open testing to production for 10% of phones, then 50%, then all, with a stop button
why: Today production is done by hand in Play Console about 3 days after open testing; one bad build reaches every member at once and the step is easy to forget or do wrong
impact_why: Every release reaches all members; a staged start limits a bad build to a few phones (Google Play's standard staged rollout, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: build it, but only ever started by you after your 'release' word, with the percentage typed in; it reuses the keyless Play sign-in already there.

what: A daily check of Google Play's own crash and frozen-screen rates for the phone and watch apps, opening an alert like the outage one when a new version is worse than the last
why: The crash alerts only see crashes the app itself manages to report; a crash before the app starts or a frozen screen never reaches them, and Play pushes an app with bad rates down in search
impact_why: Bad rates cost store ranking and members; this catches them days before reviews do
my_view: My view: worth it after the staged rollout; same keyless sign-in, needs one extra read permission on the Play side, and the alert should go to the private crash list, not the public one.

what: A daily run that collects new Play Store reviews and star ratings for MettleUp into one private list, grouped as bug, feature ask or praise
why: Members' feature asks and complaints on Play are read only when someone opens Play Console; the feedback lens needs them in one place
impact_why: Few reviews today, but every one is a member telling us what to build, and quick replies lift the rating
my_view: My view: do it once open-testing or production reviews start coming; keep it private (reviews carry names), and replying stays a human step.

what: Stop waiting on the Firebase Test Lab robot and read Google Play's free pre-launch report instead, which runs a robot on real phones for every testing-track upload
why: The Test Lab run needs keys nobody made, so it stops green with nothing tested, and Test Lab itself is due to shut in 2027; Play already does the same crawl for free on each upload
impact_why: Real-phone crash and broken-screen checks on every release at no cost and no set-up
my_view: My view: park the Test Lab run and add 'read the pre-launch report' to the release checklist; Play's report is described as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live.

what: Use Play Console's store listing experiments to test the first two pictures and the short description against a second version, instead of replacing them in place
why: The listing run swaps the pictures for everyone at once, so nobody knows whether a new set gets more installs or fewer
impact_why: Store visitors to installs is the cheapest growth lever; an experiment shows which pictures win (Play feature as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: run one experiment once open-testing traffic is steady; it is set up in Play Console, and the listing run must not overwrite the default set while it runs.

what: Add a Hindi store listing (title, short and full description, captions) next to the English one, saying plainly the app itself is in English
why: The listing run only ever writes the English (US) listing, so phones set to Hindi see English store text
impact_why: Many Indian gym members keep their phone in Hindi; store text in their language lifts installs
my_view: My view: worth a try, but only with honest words that the screens are English, or members install and uninstall; the run already takes a language, so the work is the words.

what: A simple public status page for gym owners ('Admin app: working', 'Member sign-in: working') fed by the same 10-minute check, linked from the admin app's help
why: When something is down, only the owner gets the alert; gym owners and desk staff do not know whether the fault is theirs or ours, so they call or message
impact_why: Fewer 'is it me?' calls during an outage and more trust from paying gyms
my_view: My view: later, once there are more paying gyms; it should show only up or down per part, never the backup or key details the alert issue carries.

what: At the end of each release run, one plain summary on the run page: version, which Play tracks it reached (phone and watch), any track skipped with a warning, and the What's new lines sent
why: Today a skipped closed or open track shows only as a warning line inside the log, so a green run can hide a missed track
impact_why: Saves reading logs after every release and makes a missed track obvious
my_view: My view: do it; a few lines, like the summary the phone test run already writes for its own results.

what: Put the member's What's new lines on the public GitHub release page instead of the automatic list of code changes
why: The release page shows code-change titles meant for us, while the plain member notes are already built and attached as a file
impact_why: Members who update outside Play see plain notes; internal titles stop showing on a public page
my_view: My view: do it when next touching the release run; the notes file is already made in the same run.
